| mass | 5 kg | Brochure-class public figures for a 5 kg VTOL, EXCEPT wingAreaM2, which is no longer asserted: it is derived from the drawing by geometry.planformMethod and gated by frontend/tests/airframe-truth.test.mjs. It read 0.9 m2 until 2026-09-16 — 2.9x the area the aircraft actually has — because the physics record and the drawing were two unconnected descriptions of 'the aircraft' that never met in code. | hover power | 900 W | brochure-class |
| cruise power | 180 W | brochure-class |
| battery | 300 Wh | Reserve is never spent by the sim; endurance is quoted on the usable 80%. |
| beam power | 2000 W | BOUNDING ESTIMATE ONLY - not design evidence and not a real weapon. Chosen so the dwell a player feels lands where the game wants it: well under a second in close, a few seconds at the gimbal's declared range, and a slog beyond it. Range matters because the beam spreads and the air absorbs, which is the one physical fact the whole engagement turns on. Fine-track lock is 0.35 s: the director needs that long back on a target before full power, so flicking between targets is a losing tactic and holding is the game. |
| shield | 3 J/cm² | Independence Day: the shield absorbs first and nothing reaches the airframe until it fails. Ender's Game and the operator's own words: a defeated aircraft is DISABLED and flown down under control, never deleted in the air. Battle House: it comes back, it is not exterminated. |
